prompts.title: Ballpoint Pen Drawing of Handsome Male
prompts.prompt:
Create an ultra-detailed micro-detail blue ink portrait of a handsome man, rendered entirely with extremely fine ballpoint-pen style strokes on clean white paper. Show a chest-up, three-quarter portrait, with the head slightly turned to the side and the subject gazing thoughtfully toward the right.
Capture the face with exceptional precision: sharp facial details, expressive deep-set eyes, naturally shaped eyebrows, detailed lips, and subtle skin pores and natural facial lines. Reproduce every facial contour using thousands of tiny blue-ink hatching, cross-hatching, stippling, and delicate line strokes.
The hair should be highly detailed and voluminous, with individual flowing strands, layered strokes, loose flyaway hairs, and realistic directional texture. Make the eyes especially intricate with tiny iris details and subtle ink shading.
He is wearing a classic open-collar button-up shirt, with realistic fabric folds and fine parallel ink lines. Use dense micro-hatching around the neck, jaw, hair, and shadow areas while keeping the highlights mostly untouched white paper.
Style: traditional hand-drawn ballpoint pen / fine-liner ink illustration, monochromatic deep blue ink, extremely intricate micro-linework, realistic cross-hatching, stippling, fine contour lines, controlled tonal gradients, delicate imperfections of handmade drawing, museum-quality pen portrait.
Background: completely clean white paper, minimal and uncluttered, with no objects or scenery.
Lighting & Detail: subtle directional lighting represented entirely through ink density, extremely high line precision, realistic skin texture, dimensional facial shading, crisp edges, intricate hair strands, micro-details visible even when zoomed in, authentic hand-drawn appearance. Aspect ratio: 4:5 vertical, centered portrait, 8K high-resolution.
Negative prompt: color painting, watercolor, pencil, vector art, CGI, 3D render, cartoon, anime, colored background, text, logo, watermark, distorted anatomy, blurry details.

prompts.title: The Giant's Breath
prompts.prompt:
Create a high-quality digital painting, semi-realistic stylized illustration, whimsical surrealism, ultra-detailed painterly rendering with smooth blended textures, soft gradients, and a highly polished cinematic finish.
Subject 1 (Giant Figure): A youthful person with a Smooth glowing skin. Features include glossy, softly tinted lips, subtle eyeliner, dark eyes, and large polished gold hoop earrings.
Subject 2 (Miniature Figure): A tiny exact replica of the main subject, maintaining identical facial features, hairstyle, and styling details.
Outfits: Both figures wear a cozy cream-colored ribbed knit turtleneck sweater with visible woven texture and soft natural folds. The miniature figure additionally wears a brown plaid pleated skirt paired with classic white lace-up sneakers.
Pose & Interaction: The giant figure gently extends one hand forward with the palm facing upward, carefully supporting the miniature figure standing on it. The larger figure leans forward with softly pursed lips, blowing a visible stream of stylized wind toward the tiny figure. The airflow appears as elegant swirling semi-transparent white currents with subtle volumetric motion. The miniature figure struggles to maintain balance, leaning backward dramatically with arms raised defensively against the gust.
Expressions: Calm, focused, and subtly playful expression on the giant figure, with eyes directed downward toward the tiny figure. The miniature figure displays a startled, wide-eyed reaction with an open mouth and tense body language conveying surprise and instability.
Lighting: Soft diffused studio lighting with delicate dewy highlights on the nose tip, cheekbones, eyelids, and glossy lips. Smooth realistic shading enhances facial depth, sweater texture, and hand anatomy. Subtle volumetric illumination interacts naturally with the wind effect.
Background: Minimal clean pastel teal-gray backdrop with a soft matte finish, creating strong visual separation while maintaining a calm editorial aesthetic.
Camera Angle & Composition: Medium close-up composition with an intimate eye-level perspective focused on the larger figure. Macro-style depth and scale contrast emphasize the surreal interaction between the giant and miniature figures. Balanced composition with the hand and tiny figure positioned prominently in the foreground.
Technical Details: Ultra-detailed 8K digital artwork, masterpiece quality, semi-realistic anatomy, highly refined knit fabric detailing, individually rendered hair strands, soft cinematic color grading, clean linework, subtle atmospheric depth, volumetric wind effects, smooth painterly shading, premium stylized illustration aesthetic.
Aspect ratio 4:5

prompts.title: Painted Blue
prompts.prompt:
An ultra-detailed watercolor portrait of myself.

CRITICAL:

Use the reference image only for face and identity.
Respect the facial bone structure and proportions 100%.
Do not modify any facial features.

COMPOSITION:
Medium-short 3/4 angle portrait. Subject occupies approximately 67–75% of the frame. Body is angled slightly to the left side, with shoulders turned naturally away from the camera, while the head is gently rotated back toward the camera. Balanced headroom and clean framing with upper torso visible. Direct eye contact.

FACE:
Warm skin tone with realistic texture, expressive eyes acting as the focal point, and a subtle, natural soft smile (not wide, not exaggerated) with slight asymmetry.

HAIR:
Well-groomed, color matching the attached photo, organic volume, with soft watercolor edges.

STYLE:
Professional watercolor on cold-press paper, utilizing granulating pigments, transparent layering, and a blend of soft and defined edges. The final image should not have a filter effect.

LIGHTING:
Soft natural side lighting with warm tones, clean transitions, and no opaque whites.

CLOTHING:
A red t-shirt layered under a worn denim jacket, featuring realistic texture and moderate contrast that does not compete with the face.

BACKGROUND:
A neutral watercolor wash with organic blooms and splatters, integrated softly with the silhouette.

EDGE TREATMENT (CRITICAL):
The lower part of the subject (torso area) must softly dissolve and blend into the background using watercolor bleed, diffusion, and irregular fading edges — no hard cut, no sharp boundary.

MOOD:
Elegant, natural, intimate, showing an effortless confident presence.

QUALITY:
High definition, fine detail, showcasing realistic pigment behavior.

FORMAT:
Vertical orientation (3:4).
